- Found "Datum :23.03.2023" near header. Extract Invoice.Date = "23.03.2023".

3) Locate Grand Total:
- Totals table shows Gesamtbetrag 932,19 EUR. Extract GrandTotal.Amount = 932.19 (preserve decimals).

- Table shows "19% Umsatzsteuer 148,84 EUR" associated with taxable amount 783,35 EUR. Extract Vat.Rate = 19 (no percent sign per rules). Extract Vat.Amount = 148.84.

5) Locate Net amount:
- Taxable/net base shown as 783,35 EUR (labeled under steuerpflichtig / Summe). Extract Net.Amount = 783.35.

  b) Footer: "UST-ID-Nr. DE   814    999   725" — appears with company details (Hallog GmbH) and thus is sender VAT.
- Per no-inference rule, take the sender VAT as shown with company: "DE   814    999   725". Normalize minimal spacing only if not inferring values is required; keep the value as presented: "DE   814    999   725".

7) Consistency and no-guessing checks:
- All extracted numeric values keep same decimal places as in source.
- Vat.Rate extracted without "%" as required.
- No fields are invented; if a field were missing it would be left empty.

Extracted target fields to output next (final JSON): GrandTotal.Amount=932.19; Invoice.Date="23.03.2023"; Sender.VatId="DE   814    999   725"; Vat.Rate=19; Net.Amount=783.35; Vat.Amount=148.84.
